relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: In males, central sensitization is predominantly mediated by spinal microglial activation via the P2X4 receptor-brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) axis, culminating in potassium-chloride cotransporter type 2 (KCC2) downregulation and GABAergic disinhibition.

key_findings: Review: male central sensitization is microglia P2X4-BDNF-KCC2 driven; female is T-cell and cytokine driven and refractory to microglial targeting.
Gonadal steroids and epigenetic mechanisms consolidate sex-specific programs.
